claim.claim-text: 1. An apparatus for imposing electric fields through a target region in a body of a patient, the apparatus comprising:

at least one transducer array (14) having a plurality of electrode elements (18) configured for placement on the body of the patient, the plurality of electrode elements (18) being configured to provide tumor treating fields (TTFields) via an alternating current waveform; characterized by:

a sensor array (90; 90a; 90b; 90c; 90d) having at least one first temperature sensor (16; 16a; 16a, b) and at least one second temperature sensor (16; 16d; 16e; 16f; 16e, f), wherein the at least one first temperature sensor (16; 16a; 16a, b) is connected to first and second conductors (30; 30a, d; 30a, e; 30a, f; 30a, c) and the at least one second temperature sensor (16; 16d; 16e; 16f; 16e, f) is connected to the first conductor (30; 30a) and a third conductor (30; 30e; 30f; 30g; 30d); and a controller (80) configured to:

2. The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the sensor array (90; 90d) further comprises at least one first electronic switch (92; 92a, b) in circuit with the at least one first temperature sensor (16; 16a, b) and at least one second electronic switch (92; 92e, f) in circuit with the at least one second temperature sensor (16; 16e, f).

3. The apparatus of claim 2, wherein the controller (80) is configured to provide selective activation of the at least one first electronic switch (92; 92a, b) or the at least one second electronic switch (92; 92e, f).

4. The apparatus of claim 2, wherein the at least one first electronic switch (92; 92a, b) and the at least one second electronic switch (92; 92e, f) are configured to conduct upon a predetermined polarity being placed across a respective one of the first and second conductors (30; 30a, c) and the first and third conductors (30; 30a, d), and thereby a respective one of the at least one first electronic switch (92; 92a, b) and the at least one second electronic switch (92; 92e, f).
5. The apparatus of claim 2, wherein the at least one first electronic switch (92; 92a, b) is positioned in series with the respective at least one first temperature sensor (16; 16a, b).
6. The apparatus of claim 2, wherein the at least one second electronic switch (92; 92e, f) is positioned in series with the respective at least one second temperature sensor (16; 16e, f).

7. The apparatus of claim 1, wherein the sensor array (90; 90d) comprises first and second first temperature sensors (16; 16a, b) connected to the first and second conductors (30; 30a, c) and first and second second temperature sensors (16; 16e, f) connected to the first and third conductors (30; 30a, d), and the sensor array (90; 90d) includes first and second first electronic switches (92; 92a, b) positioned in circuit with respective ones of the first and second first temperature sensors (16; 16a, b) and first and second second electronic switches (92; 92e, f) positioned in circuit with respective ones of the first and second second temperature sensors (16; 16e, f), such that one of a negative or positive polarity across the first and second conductors (30; 30a, c) results in a voltage across a respective one of the first and second first temperature sensors (16; 16a, b) and the other of a negative or positive polarity across the first and second conductors (30; 30a, c) results in a voltage across the other of the first and second first temperature sensors (16; 16a, b) and one of a negative or positive polarity across the first and third conductors (30; 30a, d) results in a voltage across a respective one of the first and second second temperature sensors (16; 16e, f) and the other of a negative or positive polarity across the first and third conductors (30; 30a, d) results in a voltage across the other of the first and second second temperature sensors (16; 16e, f).

8. The apparatus of claim 7, wherein the first and second first electronic switches (92; 92a, b) are positioned in series with the respective ones of the first and second first temperature sensors (16; 16a, b).

9. The apparatus of claim 7, wherein the first and second second electronic switches (92; 92e, f) are positioned in series with the respective ones of the first and second second temperature sensors (16; 16e, f).
